ItemID: NA; Title: We Are Not Alone       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Fits the melodic hard rock I enjoy, but I would choose heavier music this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: The End of Heartache; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: The mix of heavy riffs and melodic vocals fits my recent In Flames and Soilwork listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: City of Evil       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its energetic metal fits my taste, but it is behind my strongest choices today.
ItemID: NA; Title: As Daylight Dies; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Melodic metalcore sounds appealing given my interest in heavy music with memorable hooks.
ItemID: NA; Title: Decemberunderground; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its emphasis on emo and electronic textures is less appealing than the riff-heavy music I want now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Undertow       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: After listening to 10.000 Days, I would like to explore more of Tool's heavy, intricate sound.
ItemID: NA; Title: Iv; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not tell me enough to choose it confidently.
ItemID: NA; Title: Mezmerize       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its angular riffs and forceful vocals appeal, but I would save it for another session.
ItemID: NA; Title: Vol. 3: The Subliminal Verses; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The combination of aggression and melody suits my interest in Disturbed and heavier metal.
ItemID: NA; Title: Phobia; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic hard rock fits my listening history, but I have enough stronger picks this time.
